_comment: sim-preplace-accel-limit-reject-v1 bounded GPU acceptance hand-off. Purpose: prove the arm plan ACCELERATION gate -- every submitted plan (cuMotion+TOTG joint/pose plans AND the explicit collision-off waypoint paths) is uniformly time-reparameterised against the simulation FollowJointTrajectory executor's interpolated-acceleration ceiling (max_speed*0.5/0.15 = 1.0 rad/s^2 at the default --max-speed 0.3) BEFORE submission, so the carton_level-OFF collect place PRE-PLACE is slowed to fit instead of being REJECTED at the executor ('interpolated acceleration limit violation' -> HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=preplace, moveit_err=-4 -> arm command heartbeat lost; warmacc4). There is NO config key -- the gate is an always-on safety net in RosMotionPort's submission path, so a run whose plans are already within the ceiling is byte-identical apart from an absent PLAN_RETIME_FOR_EXEC console line.
_no_config_key: This lane adds NO mission-runtime / HOST / ENV key. Do not edit the ~/datasets runtime configs. The gate ships with the code on fm/twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1 once this PR merges.

_run_OFF_carton_level._command: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... (the warmacc4 acceptance config: cold collect-only, --stop-after collect/place, RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1, carton_level OFF/absent)
_run_OFF_carton_level._setup: carton_level OFF (absent) -- the collect place pre-place routes through begin_joint_goal -> cuMotion joint-space plan + MoveIt AddTimeOptimalParameterization (the warmacc4 path).
_run_OFF_carton_level._pass_criteria: PASS = the pre-place move is ACCEPTED by the executor (no 'TRAJ_HOST_GOAL_REJECT plan rejected at goal: interpolated acceleration limit violation', no 'HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=preplace' moveit_err=-4). If the cuMotion+TOTG plan exceeds the executor ceiling it is SLOWED in place -- the console shows one 'PLAN_RETIME_FOR_EXEC scale=S peak_accel X->Y (limit 1.000) ...' line at the pre-place and the move proceeds. FAIL = the pre-place is rejected, OR any arm command streams before a 'plan exceeds acceleration limit: <joint> <value> > <limit>' refusal (a genuinely un-retimable plan must refuse BY NAME at plan time, never surface as a lost heartbeat).

_run_ON_carton_level._command: scripts/run_mobile_restock.py ... (the coldwin33 acceptance config: cold collect-only, carton_level ON)
_run_ON_carton_level._setup: carton_level ON -- the pre-place routes through begin_joint_path (the explicit leveled 12-/9-waypoint path), far under the ceiling.
_run_ON_carton_level._pass_criteria: PASS = UNCHANGED behaviour -- the leveled pre-place is accepted exactly as before, the gate is a no-op (no PLAN_RETIME_FOR_EXEC line, scale == 1, byte-identical). This proves the always-on gate does not perturb the already-passing levelled path.

_heartbeat_check: On a genuinely un-retimable plan the mission fails with the NAMED 'plan exceeds acceleration limit: <joint> <value> > <limit>' (or, for a controller-side rejection, the moveit_err=-4 'arm controller aborted trajectory ...'), preserved as the terminal reason over the controlled stop's 'arm command heartbeat lost' (PR 316 controlled_stop keeps the heartbeat alive via suppress_heartbeat while the carton is welded; this lane only adds those reasons to controlled_stop.TRIP_MARKERS so prefer_first_trip keeps them).
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_preplace_accel_limit.py -- fixtures are the REAL recorded warmacc4 (OFF) and coldwin33 (ON) plans (scripts/twin/tests/fixtures/preplace_accel_limit_plans.json). Run: env -u PYTHONPATH PYTHONPATH=scripts PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest scripts/twin/tests/test_restock_preplace_accel_limit.py -q
